ns2:course.label: Mythology of Greece and Rome
ns2:course.description: Studies the major myths of Greece and Rome and their impact upon later art, music, and literature. Shares two hours of lecture with CLCV 111; additional hour of lecture-discussion for a closer analysis of topics. Credit is not given for both CLCV 115 and CLCV 111.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both CLCV 115 and CLCV 111.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Literature and the Arts, and Western Compartv Cult course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: In the Fall and Spring semesters, students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
